DiagnosticHelp:
Local checks only: adapter, address, Windows network profile and server status. Firewall access and Wi-Fi isolation are not tested.

1. Same network: connect PC and phone to the same local network. Disable a VPN temporarily only if your network policy permits it.
2. Guest Wi-Fi: guest networks can isolate devices; use a trusted network that allows local connections.
3. Firewall: check LAN Drop is allowed on your trusted Private/Domain network.
4. Profile: sharing stops on Public or Unknown profiles. Verify your network is trusted before changing its profile.
5. Address changes or sleep: after changing Wi-Fi or waking the PC, check the selected address, start sharing again if needed and scan a new QR code. Old sessions may no longer work.
6. Phone: keep the browser visible and the screen awake during transfers. Interrupted files require a new transfer; retry does not resume bytes.

No network or firewall settings are changed.
NetworkBlocked: Sharing is blocked on Public or Unknown networks. Choose a trusted Private/Domain interface, or loopback for local testing.

TransfersHelp: This sharing session only, up to 200 recent transfers. Completed outbound preparation makes a file available to the phone; it does not confirm a download. Open folder shows the currently selected receive folder.
RetryHelp: {0} files retained for manual retry. A missing server response may mean the last file was already saved: check the overview first to avoid a duplicate. Retry starts over and checks the source contents again. Clear unfinished selection removes only this pending list, not completed files.
RetrySelectRecipient: Select the intended approved recipient explicitly before retrying.
RetryPending: Retry or clear the unfinished selection before choosing a new group. Clearing the selection does not delete completed files.
RetryCleared: Unfinished selection cleared. Completed shared and received files are kept.
